lemmas.primary_translation: to benefit from / to be just what someone deserves

examples.no: han kunne hatt godt av å slappe litt av
examples.en: he could have benefited from relaxing a little

definitions.translation: to be just what someone deserves

examples.no: de fikk kjeft, men det hadde de bare godt av
examples.en: they got scolded, but it did them good
